fpsmaxx.screen.title: FPSMaxx Graphics Preset
fpsmaxx.sodium.open.tooltip: Choose FpsMaxx, Fast, Fancy, Fabulous or Custom. FpsMaxx applies the hidden optimization profile.
options.graphics.fpsmaxx.tooltip: FPSMaxx: applies every FPSMaxx optimization, including culling, particle limits and chunk-update budgeting that the normal graphics presets cannot reach.
options.graphics.fpsmaxx.tooltip.freshsm: FPSMaxx (Fresh & Smooth safe): applies the FPSMaxx governor, culling and chunk budget while preserving the pack's shaders, particles and animations.
